_comment: Production trust policy that trusts a CI IDENTITY (keyless), not a key. The `includes` are GENERATED from artifact-spec.json by tools/spec_includes.py and validated in CI, so discovery, signing and the policy cannot drift. Optional files (e.g. AGENTS.md) appear here only when present, matching nono semantics. The signed .nono-inventory is the authority on which files must exist; verify_artifact.py enforces that. Replace my-org/payments-api with your repo, then sign this file: `nono trust sign-policy`.
